clue.text: Thoroughfare that, in short, takes up half of Oxford!

definitions.text: Thoroughfare that, in short, takes up half of Oxford!

parts.words: Thoroughfare that, in short, takes up half of Oxford!
parts.note: a playful description: in shorthand a ring is the letter O and a crossing road the letter X, and those two letters make up the first half of the city's name

explanation.surface: A boast that some great road swallows up half the city of Oxford.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'in short' as abbreviation: O looks like a ring and X like a crossroads, so OX, half of Oxford, is literally a ring and a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A circular bypass road around a town is a kind of thoroughfare carrying traffic.

clue.text: Home on Urals after storm becoming cut off

parts.note: IN means at home

indicators.note: the Urals are thrown about as if by a storm, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A house in the Ural mountains is isolated once a storm has blown through.
explanation.definitionFit: Insular describes being isolated, like an island, so it matches cut off.

clue.text: Northerner participating in binge or dieting?

indicators.note: the answer takes part in the run of words that follows, sitting inside it letter for letter

explanation.surface: Asks whether a northerner is a feaster or a dieter.
explanation.walkthrough: A Geordie is a person from Tyneside, around Newcastle in north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Newcastle upon Tyne is a specific kind of English northerner.

clue.text: Career misdoing — systematically arranged in this?

definitions.text: Career misdoing — systematically arranged in this?

indicators.note: the two words are put into a new, ordered arrangement, so their letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Suggests a lifetime of wrongdoing would be found within a structured criminal enterprise.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: rearranging the letters of 'Career misdoing' gives the answer, which is also where systematically arranged misdoing happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Gangs and mafias run wrongdoing as a structured business, a lifelong vocation in crime.

clue.text: Energy in a small drink? That's fantasy

indicators.note: the energy letter is placed inside the small drink

parts.note: a dram is a small measure of spirits
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A little tot of something giving a boost seems too good to be true.
explanation.definitionFit: A dream is an imagined scene or wish, a synonym for fantasy.

clue.text: Acknowledges vanity — not the thing with some in Paris

indicators.note: 'not the thing' tells us to drop the word for 'the thing' from vanity

parts.note: conceit means vanity
IT is the thing
des is French for 'some'

explanation.surface: Someone admits to vanity while disowning something they did in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: To concede is to admit or grant a point, a synonym for acknowledges.

clue.text: Louts — a number in riot such as cannot be overcome

indicators.note: the words run riot, so their letters are rearranged into disorder

explanation.surface: A gang of louts in a riot proves impossible to control.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is all fourteen letters of 'Louts a number in', with 'riot' as the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Insurmountable describes an obstacle too great to get over, i.e. unbeatable.

clue.text: Church work — I name composer

parts.note: OP, for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A church piece by its creator, named as a famous composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Frédéric Chopin was the Polish Romantic piano composer.

clue.text: Silver revolver initially carried by spy

indicators.note: the agent holds the letter inside, as one carries a gun

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy

indicators.note: only the opening letter of revolver is used

explanation.surface: A silver gun carried by a secret agent, as in a spy thriller.
explanation.walkthrough: Argent is the heraldic word for silver.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry the metal tincture silver is called by its French-derived name.

clue.text: Personal grant

explanation.surface: Reads like a scholarship or bursary awarded to one individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Something personal is one's own, and to grant a point is to own it.

clue.text: Fern that would be ruined by another gust

indicators.note: a ruined thing is broken up, so these letters are reassembled in a different order

explanation.surface: A delicate plant would be wrecked by one more blast of wind.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodland plant with long strap-like fronds, a named species of fern.

clue.text: Screw up, bottom in class, fifth grade

indicators.note: the backside is put within the class abbreviation

parts.note: CL is an abbreviation for class
the rump is the backside
E is the fifth grade after A, B, C and D

explanation.surface: A school report: a pupil messed up, came bottom of the class and scored a lowly grade.
explanation.definitionFit: To screw up paper is to crush it into a ball, which is to crumple it.

clue.text: Resin rendering car number only half visible

parts.note: Lada is a Russian make of car

indicators.note: just the first half of the word number shows

explanation.surface: A sticky resin has smeared a car's number plate so only part can be read.
explanation.definitionFit: Labdanum is a fragrant gum from rockrose shrubs, a natural resin used in perfume.

clue.text: Powerful person in party threatening endlessly

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: the word for threatening loses its final letter

parts.note: minatory means threatening

explanation.surface: A menacing figure at a social gathering who never stops making threats.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dominates others holds power over them, a ruling or controlling figure.

clue.text: Support learner — no trouble to start with

indicators.note: the word for no trouble comes first, before the learner

parts.note: ease is freedom from difficulty
L is the learner abbreviation, from L-plates on cars

explanation.surface: Reassurance to a beginner that there is nothing hard at first.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is a stand that holds up a painting or board, a kind of support.

clue.text: Member forced into a diplomatic mission

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body

indicators.note: the words are forced out of shape, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A club member is pushed into joining an embassy delegation.
explanation.definitionFit: A legation is a diplomatic office headed by a minister, below an embassy in rank.

clue.text: Restrict exploit

definitions.meaning: to hold back growth, as poor diet can do
a daring feat or showy trick

explanation.surface: Reads as limiting someone's daring feat or curbing how something is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Stunting growth limits it, and a daring feat is a dramatic piece of showmanship.

clue.text: Heartless robber taking everything — first descent into wickedness

indicators.note: the robber word loses its central letter

parts.note: a thief is a robber
all means everything

explanation.surface: A cruel robber grabs the lot, beginning a slide into crime.
explanation.walkthrough: The two words name Adam and Eve's original sin in Eden.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, humanity's first lapse into sin is when Adam and Eve eat the forbidden fruit.

clue.text: Pig cooled off — a beast sniffing around looking for something?

definitions.text: a beast sniffing around looking for something?

indicators.note: the letters go off, as in spoilt, and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pig has calmed down while some animal sniffs about searching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pig' is slang for a police officer, which helps the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A sniffer dog used by the police searches for drugs or suspects by scent.

clue.text: After river endure (as a Scot might) problem on the road

indicators.note: the word for endure follows the river name

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river
thole is a Scots word meaning to endure

explanation.surface: Someone tolerating a nuisance once past a river crossing, with a Scottish twist.
explanation.definitionFit: A hole in the road surface is a hazard for drivers.

clue.text: Greek character is innocent type brought before US prosecutor

indicators.note: the lamb is placed in front of the prosecutor

parts.note: a lamb is a byword for innocence
DA is a District Attorney, an American public prosecutor

explanation.surface: An innocent person in Greece is hauled up before an American prosecutor.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet, equivalent to L.

clue.text: Nut needing money given conflicting directions

parts.note: cash is money
E and W, east and west, point opposite ways

explanation.surface: A madman needing funds is pulled in opposite directions.
explanation.definitionFit: A kidney-shaped edible kernel from a tropical tree is a type of nut.

clue.text: Most pretentiously showy Italian somersaulting during a break

indicators.note: the reversed piece sits within the break

parts.note: a rest is a break

indicators.note: flipping head over heels turns the short word back to front

parts.note: IT is short for Italian, as in Italian vermouth

explanation.surface: A flamboyant Italian performing acrobatics during an interval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Italian' is the usual crossword shorthand for Italian vermouth; 'somersaulting' turns it head over heels before it lands in the break.
explanation.definitionFit: Arty means affectedly artistic, so the superlative describes the most affectedly showy.

clue.text: Gangster getting mean makes one suffer

parts.note: Al Capone is the crossword's usual gangster
low means mean or base

explanation.surface: A nasty gangster inflicts pain on someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffer' is in its old sense of permit, as in 'suffer the little children'.
explanation.definitionFit: To suffer in the archaic sense is to tolerate or permit, a synonym for let happen.

clue.text: Animal from Noah's vessel about to be covered in mould

indicators.note: the reversed vessel is wrapped inside the mould word

parts.note: must is mould or mustiness

indicators.note: turned about, the vessel is read backwards

parts.note: Noah built the ark

explanation.surface: A creature from the ark is going mouldy.
explanation.definitionFit: A North American aquatic rodent, so it is an animal.

clue.text: Crossbreed produced in scientist's room — something roughly sketched by artist

parts.note: a lab is a laboratory
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
a doodle is an idle rough drawing

explanation.surface: A hybrid created in a lab, plus a rough sketch from an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A cross between a Labrador retriever and a poodle, a hybrid dog breed.

clue.text: Sound of animal in desolate place with river dried up

indicators.note: the river runs dry, so its letter disappears

parts.note: a moor is open bleak upland

explanation.surface: An animal's cry heard on a bleak moor where the stream has run dry.
explanation.definitionFit: The low call a cow makes is the sound of that animal.

clue.text: Cyclist's manoeuvres bringing shout of delight and stories later

indicators.note: the stories come after the shout

parts.note: whee is a cry of glee
lies are tall stories

explanation.surface: A cyclist whoops with joy and tells tall tales afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding a bicycle on its back wheel with the front raised is a stunt.
